items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: And if he said 'now I'm not supposed to tell you when to drink, what to drink. That's for you to know, and for you to do. If you don't have the money and I buy you a bottle, I'll sit it there, and I'll use it. You have to take it from there.' And he could drink all night and all day and come to work

ctx.x: And you could die, and a lot of people did die, and it -- I was a runner. She'd come up and say 'hey Buddy.' I'd say okay. I'd go out and get a pint, and a half pint, and we'd take -- give one to her, and throw the bottle and drink, and she'd pass it to me, and she would take the bottle and throw it against the brick wall -- sprrrnng -- nng -- nng. You know.
